text:
erin: Quick sync — I just discovered a mismatch between console-preview counts and what the router actually used during the last config roll. small canary (2%) showed 0 changes applied in metrics.
kevin: oof. which rollout path? preview vs apply?
ersin: tldr; I clicked apply instead of dry-run, but more concerning: console preview API returns a different set from /config/evaluate.
sasha: do we have sampling differences? preview can use a lighter sample (1k reqs) while evaluate runs on streaming live sample. that would explain it.
kevin: can you paste the payload you used?
ersin: sure — payload was: 
```
POST /api/v1/flags/rollout
{
  "flag": "enable_coalesce_v2",
  "scope": "tenant:cohort-A",
  "percent": 2,
  "mode": "apply"
}
```
sasha: curious — our operator code path for coalesce has a fast-path that only activates for percent < 5 to reduce churn. preview path intentionally bypasses it.
TJ: that fast-path was added for performance but it means telemetry diverges. we should add a "shadow" mode that records what would change without toggling the fast-path.
kevin: +1 for shadow mode. ops wants deterministic sampling so alerts don't get confused. shadow should: 1) not mutate routing tables 2) emit full diff + hash for each tenant 3) tag telemetry with rollout_id.
ersin: agree. can we extend the preview API instead of adding another verb? worried about UX noise.
sasha: proposal: keep POST /rollout?mode=preview for lightweight preview (stats only), and add POST /rollout?mode=shadow for full-diff dry-run. shadow will run coalesce code path but never commit; it will mirror what apply would do.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — any new rollout modes require: docs, console dropdown update, quota guard change, telemetry schema bump.
kevin: quota guard change — shadow runs can be heavier CPU; we should exempt shadow from burst quota but cap total concurrent shadows per org to avoid DoS.
TJ: sanity check on telemetry — we need a stable sampling key so we can compare preview vs shadow vs apply. suggest using rollout_id + tenant_id as sample key.
ersin: implemented a quick patch locally. sample output: 
```
shadow-result: {"tenant":"acme", "would_change":true, "diff_hash":"0x7fa3"}
```
kevin: nice. next steps: 1) api contract PR (sasha) 2) console dropdown + help text (design) 3) ops-rate limit change (tj) 4) telemetry schema PR (kevin).
sasha: i'll draft the API PR. question: should shadow-mode run on a separate fleet? pros: safer isolation. cons: more infra.
TJ: separate fleet recommended for initial rollout. we can co-locate later once stable.
kevin: timeline?
ersin: i'll freeze the accidental apply history for the tenants hit and open a rollback if needed. can we aim for API PR by end of day tomorrow and shadow fleet smoke by end of week?
sasha: yeah i'll push a draft this afternoon.
ops-bot: noted — created ticket INF-2319 for shadow-mode rollout.
kevin: thanks all. small follow-up: add a telemetry field `shadow_mode=true|false` so dashboards can filter.
TJ: added to checklist.
ersin: thanks, team. saved a bunch of nerves. :relieved:
